newsitem.title: GERMANY: Thyssen awaiting details of Krupp offer.
newsitem.headline: Thyssen awaiting details of Krupp offer.

text.p: German steel and engineering group Thyssen AG said at a news conference on Tuesday it is waiting for details of Hoesch-Krupp's hostile takeover bid, but emphasised that it would seek to fight off the bid.
Thyssen chairman Dieter Vogel added that the company intended to fend off the bid with all means at its disposal.
"We are waiting for an explanation from Krupp of what they intend to do, which hasn't happened today," he told a news conference at Thyssen headquarters in Duesseldorf.
Vogel said he was mystified how the "financially weak" Krupp intended to finance the takeover bid and what parts of Thyssen they intended to sell off.
